339-677-4927-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2390-6191-7436.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-7436.description:
Gain life.
Pest Mascot triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4828-5261-7014.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4828-5261-7014.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

512-3443-5475.easyPrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-3443-5475.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
512-3443-5475.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Deathbloom Ritualist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3443-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Deathbloom Ritualist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

4881-6909-7176-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7176-8199.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Carnage to gain all creature types
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

654-2577-2921-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2577-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2866-4986-5034-8095.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sol Ring.
When Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, Scrap Trawler triggers, returning any mana value 0 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1170-2099-5131-5645--202.easyPrerequisites:
Stenn has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-5131-5645--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

4772-4826-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1580-2301-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-3099-6006-7730.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4452-5256-5659-6482.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Avenging Angel.
When Avenging Angel dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Avenging Angel's power, which will cause you to mill Avenging Angel.
As Avenging Angel is a Lhurgoyf due to Rukarumel, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Avenging Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

254-413--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station and First Day of Class trigger.
Resolve the First Day of Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2

661-3685-4659-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
661-3685-4659-6709.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Ballad of the Black Flag. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-3259-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

3257-3259-6628--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3257-3259-6628--85--106.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

647-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
647-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1409-3499.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

147-3440-6798.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

454-850-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
454-850-1978.description:
Cause Overgrown Battlement to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-4708-4986-5315.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness

2866-3689-6518-6556.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

500-1270-1308-2523.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ojer Taq and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Ojer Taq token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Ojer Taqs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2*(3^X) nonlegendary token copies of Ojer Taq that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Ojer Taqs you control.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-1270-1308-2523.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^695.6224481408007) creature tokens.

2724-3036-3194.notablePrerequisites: Wizard Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
2724-3036-3194.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2558-3698-5687-5690.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

851-1074-4222.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping King Macar.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating two Gold artifact tokens.
Activate the Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1769-2201-4727-4816.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1769-2201-4727-4816.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Infectious Host from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Infectious Host die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Infectious Host and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Infectious Host trigger, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 4.

479-1561-2041-3365.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least twenty-six cards in library.
You have at least 2 life.
479-1561-2041-3365.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss, drawing at least twelve cards and losing half your life total.
Cast Savor the Moment, gaining an extra turn.
Activate Aeromeba by discarding a card to switch Aeromeba's power and toughness until end of turn.
Repeat step 3 until you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand.
Pass to the extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, winning the game.

864-2103-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
864-2103-3742.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness that is tapped and attacking.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

1074-1651-2392.description:
Activate Clock of Omens' ability, tapping Macar and Clock of Omens, untapping Macar.
Macar triggers, exiling target creature and create a Gold token.
Activate Clock of Omens' ability, tapping Macar and the Gold token, untapping Macar.
 Repeat from step 2.

757-3932-4235.notablePrerequisites: Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
757-3932-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Hope Tender and pay {1}, by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.
